latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Quickly edit and export AI-enhanced videos with cloud rendering.

- Upload raw video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and auto-edit for TikTok and Reels in 30-60 seconds.
- Seamless onboarding: automatic backend connection and session setup with free trial credits.
- Smart command routing: supports edit instructions, export, credits check, and session state queries.
- Cloud GPU rendering pipeline for fast 1080p MP4 output with support for timeline edits, transitions, and overlays.
- Error handling and clear feedback on progress, file limits, and editing results.
